name: Something Borrowed
source:
Thalia had to turn down her friend Charlene’s request to help with the wedding – her demanding grandmother needed her attention. She trusted Charlene could handle it, confident the day would go off without a hitch.

She was very wrong.

Mid-ceremony, a dark presence traps everyone inside. Now Thalia – and perhaps a strange man no one else notices –must find a way to save them all.

[From [url=https://sudachys.itch.io/something-borrowed]Itch.io[/url]]
